title: Carrot — Plant profile
subject: Carrot
summary: Carrot is a vegetable for cool season planting, originating in Europe and Asia. Needs: 5–6 h sun; loose sandy soil; even moisture. Sweet root maturing in 70–80 days in deep soil. Field: root.
